learning_outcomes.text: Develop skills to design interactive systems in virtual worlds
Analyze and manage multimodal interfaces with natural language interaction
Know how to use virtual reality devices

syllabus_topics: T1. Introduction to natural language processing.
T2. Natural language interaction: conversational agents.
T3. Artificial Vision for non-verbal information extraction: emotions and gestures.
T4. Introduction to virtual and augmented reality: visualization, interaction and devices.
P1. Design and development of lightweight conversational agents.
P2. Integration of artificial vision into a conversational agent.
P3. Representation of information through virtual or augmented reality.
teaching_methods: Individual activities in the Virtual Campus

assessment_methods.method: Individual practice: Introduction to natural language processing (B1PracPLN)
Theoretical work on the Artificial Vision block (B2Teo)
Theoretical work on the Introduction to Virtual and Augmented Reality block (B3Teo)

assessment_rules: For each block (B1, B2, B3), a minimum grade of 5 is required for all elements. If all minimums for block B1 are met, its grade is 0.3*B1ExaTeo + 0.35*B1PracPLN + 0.35*B1PracAC. If all minimums for block B2 are met, its grade is 0.3*B2Teo + 0.7*B2PracVA. If all minimums for block B3 are met, its grade is 0.3*B3Teo + 0.7*B3PracRVA. If all block minimums are met, the final grade is (B1+B2+B3)/3; otherwise, the final grade is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. In case of doubt about authorship or unauthorized means, a presential defense may be requested.
